verdict.rationale: The app ships a built-in agent: the user types a goal and presses Start, and it runs in the background, leaving its own app to operate other apps such as Clock. Saved tasks can be triggered from Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center, and runs can be replayed step by step. missing for 10: a bundled model (the user must supply their own OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint and key), independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the project README.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Type a goal (for example "Open Settings and go to Wi-Fi") and press Start.
the agent leaves its own app, opens Clock, types the time into the wheel, ticks the days and saves.
the agent runs in an iPhone app on the same phone.
Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center can run saved tasks.
